facts.business: Sumitomo Chemical India Limited is a listed subsidiary of Sumitomo Chemical Company, Japan, engaged in manufacturing and selling crop protection, storage pest control, rodent control, bio pesticides, and plant growth regulators for Indian agriculture.

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital investment on energy conservation equipments
Capital expenditure incurred during the year on research and development

key_risks: Climatic challenges including prolonged and excess rainfall impacting crop productivity and agrochemical consumption
Commodity price pressures in key crops
Regulatory risk regarding Glyphosate usage restriction notification challenged in Delhi High Court
Impairment risk of Goodwill on acquisition of Barrix Agro Sciences Private Limited due to sensitivity of discount rate and long-term revenue growth rate assumptions
